answer: Each identity enrolls a voiceprint in the harbor registry, hashed on-chain, plus 15 POA bonded 90 days. Each epoch a random 8-word phrase is drawn from a river of 10,000 prompts, to be spoken in 60 seconds; a voice wandering across two identities forfeits both bonds, freezing payouts 3 epochs. 100 fakes need 100 voices: 1,500 POA in bonds plus 100 actors at 20 POA each, versus 15 POA for one honest user; reusing one voice across 10 identities loses 150 POA in one check, so forgery gets dearer per fake. A twin or a cold can fail, so two misses in 5 epochs trigger a human re-check.
